name: implement
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the model-backed implement-then-PR doer (DESIGN §3.6.2/§3.6.3) replaces the dry-run reference adapter, or when the Handoff schema reaches a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: auto-maintainer-framework#354: the shipped implementer subagent (ship/agents/auto-maintainer-implementer.md, now v2.7.0) now regenerates a committed build tree in-PR. When a repo checks a built distribution tree (a plugin/package tree assembled from source) into version control under a build-drift guard, the accept path — after committing the code change and before the self-review — determines whether its edits touched source mirrored into that committed tree and, if so, runs the repo's build step and commits the regenerated tree in the SAME PR. This keeps a shipped-source change drift-free in one PR instead of merging with drift and forcing a second regen-only PR. A change touching only non-mirrored source (docs/tests, or a repo with no committed build tree) does not regenerate. The instruction is phrased generically; the shipped body still references NEITHER 'rabbit-project' NOR '.rabbit'. spec.md documents the behaviour; an e2e test asserts the body carries the regen instruction and stays leak-free.
